claims.claim_text: Nano Dimension owns approximately 14.02% of Stratasys Ltd. ordinary shares (9,695,115 shares, ~$138.4M market value at year-end 2023) and made a December 2023 all-cash proposal to acquire all remaining Stratasys shares at $16.50/share.
claims.subject: Nano Dimension Ltd.
claims.object_value: Stratasys Ltd. (SSYS) - 14.02% stake; pending all-cash buyout offer at $16.50/share
claims.source_quote: We currently own approximately 14.02% of Stratasys outstanding shares and have been its largest shareholder since July 2022. ... In December 2023, we submitted a preliminary all cash proposal to purchase all the outstanding shares of Stratasys that we did not already own for $16.50 per share in cash.

claims.claim_text: Nano Dimension acquired six businesses in the past three years: DeepCube and NanoFabrica (April 2021), Essemtec AG (Nov 2021), Global Inkjet Systems / GIS (Jan 2022), Formatec Holding incl. Admatec and Formatec (July 2022), and the asset acquisition of Additive Flow (August 2023).
claims.subject: Nano Dimension Ltd.
claims.object_value: DeepCube, NanoFabrica, Essemtec, GIS, Formatec Holding, Additive Flow
claims.source_quote: we acquired all of the issued and outstanding share capital of DeepCube and NanoFabrica in April 2021, all of the issued and outstanding share capital of Essemtec in November 2021, all of the issued and outstanding share capital of GIS in January 2022, all of the issued and outstanding share capital of Formatec Holding in July 2022. ... Additive Flow, a U.K.-based company, in August 2023.

claims.claim_text: Nano Dimension's portfolio of 3D printers - including DragonFly IV (additive electronics inkjet for PCBs), Fabrica 2.0 (Micro-AM DLP) and Admaflex (industrial AM DLP for ceramic and metal parts) - has met the needs of thousands of customers in aerospace/defense, automotive, electronics/PCB, industrial, medical, and R&D/academia.
claims.subject: Nano Dimension Ltd.
claims.object_value: thousands of customers across aerospace/defense, automotive, electronics, industrial, medical sectors; products: DragonFly IV, Fabrica 2.0, Admaflex
claims.source_quote: Our portfolio of 3D printers include: (i) AME inkjet printers known as DragonFly IV ... (ii) Micro Additive Manufacturing (Micro-AM) Digital Light Processing, or DLP, printers known as Fabrica 2.0 ... (iii) Industrial AM DLP printers known as Admaflex ... critical components that have met the needs of thousands of customers in the most technologically advanced, competitive, and innovative industries such as aerospace/defense, automotive, electronics and PCB, industrial, medical, and research and development/academia.
